name: NOAA coastal water-level stations and CONUS radar (remaining NOAA family)

scenarios.prompt: Show coastal water level stations around Charleston, South Carolina.
Show current radar over Houston, Texas.

fixes.summary: Add `noaa` to _BACKEND_RASTER_PROVIDERS so NOAA radar tiles route through the same-origin AEGIS tile proxy instead of a direct upstream browser request, matching the FEMA/ESA/GIBS/RainViewer raster pattern.

Declare structured WMS metadata (layer_id, crs, format, wms_version, style, wms_exceptions) with a bare base url_template so the proxy builds a single-parameter WMS GetMap instead of duplicating the hardcoded query.

remaining_limitation: CO-OPS and radar render with accepted acknowledgements; NOAA CO-OPS endpoint_health is `partial` and radar coverage is CONUS-only by provider design. Valid-empty/stale per-NOAA-response semantics were not separately exercised this run.
